   written as `.mmd.txt` so they behave like other text bundle artifacts.
 
 The default value is `{project}-docs-exports`.
 
+=== `docs.root_level`
+
+`docs.root_level` controls how Antora assemblies are exported to markdown.
+
+* `0` writes one combined assembly for the playbook.
+* `1` writes one markdown file per Antora assembly or module.
+
+This setting applies to both `cx docs export` and
+`cx bundle --include-doc-exports`. You can override it per command with
+`cx docs export --root-level` or `cx bundle --docs-root-level`.
+
+The default value is `1`.
+

+{

+    "schemaVersion": {
+      "description": "Manifest schema version. Must be exactly 11.",
+      "const": 11

The LLM must treat this bundle as containing uncommitted work.",
